title: David Harbour Leaks Tony Stark's Identity in Avengers
seoTitle: David Harbour Leaks Tony Stark in Avengers
subtitle: The Red Guardian actor made a cryptic comment about the upcoming film
excerpt: Actor David Harbour raised questions about Robert Downey Jr. in Avengers: Doomsday after a cryptic comment to Variety.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Actor David Harbour ended up letting slip Tony Stark's identity in Avengers: Doomsday, raising questions about Robert Downey Jr.'s presence in the film. The actor, who plays the Red Guardian in the cinematic production, made a cryptic comment to Variety.

The statement raised more questions than answers. It remains to be seen whether his comment was an accidental slip-up or a deliberate tease by the actor.

Secrecy in Marvel Productions

Film productions typically enforce strict non-disclosure agreements to prevent plot leaks and surprise cameos before theatrical releases.

Historically, actors involved in major franchises have used various tactics to mislead the public and the press. A previous example involved actor Andrew Garfield, who repeatedly denied his involvement in Spider-Man films prior to their official theatrical release.

With information from The Guardian.
